title: Dynamics on graphs with disjoint cycles and applications
summary: In this article, we introduce the notion of connected finite graphs with disjoint cycles in normal form and show that any such graph can be transformed into a normal form graph via a finite sequence of in-splittings and out-splittings. Consequently, we provide number-theoretic criteria for meteor graphs of length three to be strongly shift equivalent, where a meteor graph of length three is a connected finite essential graph consisting of three disjoint cycles which makes a unique chain of cycles of length three.
